resources.name: GameDatabase API
resources.description: Integration request collection and test suite for the GameDatabase Spring Boot API.

resources.name: Get All Games
resources.description: Returns all games seeded in the database.

resources.name: Get Game By ID
resources.description: Returns a single game by ID.

resources.name: Get Missing Game
resources.description: Returns a bad request error for an ID that does not exist.

resources.name: Create Game
Create Game Missing Title
resources.description: Returns a validation error when a required field is missing.

resources.name: Create Game Invalid Year
resources.description: Returns a validation error when releaseYear is not four digits.

resources.name: Update Game
Update Game Invalid Year
resources.description: Returns a validation error for an invalid update year.

resources.name: Delete Game
GET /api/games returns seed data
GET /api/games/{id} returns one game
GET missing game returns 400
POST /api/games creates a game
POST missing title returns 400
POST invalid year returns 400
PUT /api/games/{id} applies partial update
PUT invalid year returns 400
DELETE /api/games/{id} removes a game
